1.quote: When someone has unwavering faith in an endeavour, they are unlikely to fail, regardless of whether their belief is right or wrong.

2.quote: The revelations of nature lie in seemingly trivial events.

3.quote: It is only when adversity strikes and lives are lost that humanity begins to realise how gravely it has underestimated the danger.

4.quote: Help others in a manner that keeps your involvement anonymous. This is how God works.

5.quote: Refrain from expressing past hardships upon achieving success; with time, they will become apparent.

6.quote: To keep the leaves fresh and beautiful, we water the roots, not the leaves.

7.quote: Even the tiniest seed possesses enough strength to push a delicate sapling through the hardest, rockiest soil.

8.quote: The only way to gain a stranger's trust is to be good at their game.

9.quote: Never show your anger towards a mob, for a single drop cannot drown you, but an ocean can.

10.quote: Fire can be used both to light up and to burn down the world; so can a human being.

11.quote: A bag contains 1,000 red balls and 1 blue ball. You close your eyes and pick one. Luck is when you get a blue ball. A miracle is when you get a green ball.

12.quote: Stay innocent. When your heart and mind are pure, you see things that others can't, you get help that others won't, and you show love that others don't.

13.quote: It is only when you have done all you can and are still lost that you should turn to him.

14.quote:
Compassion toward your enemies is a sign of a pure heart, for you are not blinded by their hatred.
Confrontation with your friends is a sign of a pure mind, for you are not blinded by their love.

15.quote: Belief makes you plant the seed. Intention brings you its fruits.

16.quote: If you do something with love and care, it feels like a hobby to you, while it looks like hard work to others.

17.quote: Take care of the words you speak; in time, they will start to shape your reality.

18.quote: What differentiates you from others defines you.

19.quote: Only three things can cause a transformation: fear of the future, love in the present, and pain from the past. In rare cases, a revelation.

20.quote: On a long journey, worry more about losing your comfort than about reaching your destination.

21.quote: The strong have the courage to apologize. The mighty have the wisdom to foresee such situations and avoid them.

22.quote: Effort does not take time. Results take time. Ironically, effort itself is a result.

23.quote: Pain by fate is an experience. Pain by choice is a conviction. One happens to you; the other reveals you.

24.quote: Better to conceal the truth than to tell a lie, for avoiding pain is wiser than seeking pleasure.

25.quote: Keep them in. Let them die inside; they will spring up beautifully sometime later. Otherwise, if you let them out, they will only serve to bury you.

26.quote: Love is born only after destiny is fulfilled. When destiny is complete, the good and bad in you die, leaving behind nothing but innocence, and from that innocence, love is born.

27.quote: Artistry, Attention, Belief and Benevolence. Together, reality will bend and bow in your favour.

28.quote: Your trust in my beliefs should not be based solely on my position in life, but rather on your own instincts. Your decisions reveal a lot about your position in life.

29.quote: Redemption comes only when you let something inside you go.

30.quote: Every smile you've unknowingly brought to someone's face carries a meaning deeper than you realize.
